blocks.text: SALT LAKE CITY — Cooper Flagg scored 28 points and made the game-winning free throws with 3.7 seconds left to lift the Dallas Mavericks over the Utah Jazz 116-114 after they squandered an 18-point lead in the fourth quarter on Sunday night. Kyrie Irving scored 16 points, all in the first half, as the Mavericks (10-7) barely avoided an epic collapse and won their third in a row.
